:::{#thm-mutual-information-kl}
#### Mutual information as a divergence

Let $X$ and $Y$ be [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv)
with joint probability mass function $p(x, y)$
and marginal probability mass functions $p(x)$ and $p(y)$.
If their entropies are finite, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
then their mutual information is the
[Kullback--Leibler divergence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-kl-divergence)
of the joint distribution from the product of the marginals:

$$I(X; Y) = \sum_{x, y} p(x, y) \log \frac{p(x, y)}{p(x) \, p(y)},$$

where the sum runs over the pairs with $p(x, y) > 0$.

:::

::: {.proof}

Write $p(y \mid x) = p(x, y) / p(x)$.
By @def-mutual-information and the definitions of
[entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy)
and [conditional entropy](#def-conditional-entropy),

$$
\begin{aligned}
I(X; Y)
&= H(Y) - H(Y \mid X) \\
&= -\sum_{y} p(y) \log p(y) + \sum_{x, y} p(x, y) \log p(y \mid x) \\
&= -\sum_{x, y} p(x, y) \log p(y) + \sum_{x, y} p(x, y) \log p(y \mid x) \\
&= \sum_{x, y} p(x, y) \sb{\log p(y \mid x) - \log p(y)} \\
&= \sum_{x, y} p(x, y) \log \frac{p(y \mid x)}{p(y)} \\
&= \sum_{x, y} p(x, y) \log \frac{p(x, y)}{p(x) \, p(y)}.
\end{aligned}
$$

The third line uses $\sum_{x} p(x, y) = p(y)$,
and the last line uses $p(y \mid x) = p(x, y) / p(x)$.
The sum in the last line is the divergence of $p(x, y)$ from $p(x) \, p(y)$
by the [discrete formula](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#thm-kl-divergence-discrete).

:::
